issues.text: The new website_name serializer attribute is not added to untrusted_attributes, so it bypasses the existing rule that hides fields like website from anonymous viewers of a TL0 user's profile, defeating an existing anti-spam protection.
issues.zh: website_name 未納入 untrusted_attributes，繞過了 TL0 使用者對匿名訪客的欄位限制。

issues.text: The include_website_name method is missing the trailing question mark that ActiveModel::Serializers requires (include_<attr>?), so it is never actually invoked and website_name is unconditionally included in every user payload.
issues.zh: include_website_name 少了問號，不符合 include_<attr>? 契約，導致該 attribute 無條件出現在每一份 user payload 上。

issues.text: The untrusted_attributes list in the serializer spec was not updated to include website_name, so there is no regression test guarding the field-masking bug.
issues.zh: spec 第 11 行的 untrusted_attributes 清單沒有一起補上 website_name。

issues.text: There is no test covering the elsif branch that the code comment itself describes (www.example.com vs forum.example.com), which is the most logically complex part of the new method.
issues.zh: 註解宣稱要處理的 www.example.com vs forum.example.com 分支完全沒有測試。

issues.text: There is no test asserting that website_name is absent from the payload when the user hasn't set a website.
issues.zh: 沒有 example 驗證使用者沒填網站時 website_name 這個 key 應該不存在。

issues.text: The 'same organization' heuristic (equal label count plus matching domain after dropping the first label) misjudges two-level public suffixes like com.br or co.uk as the same organization, causing an unrelated external domain to be shown with its full path.
issues.zh: 以「label 數相同 + 去掉第一段後相等」判斷同組織，在 com.br / co.uk 這類雙層公共後綴上會誤判。

issues.text: The rescue modifier on URI parsing (`rescue nil`) catches all StandardError, not just URI::InvalidURIError, so a website value containing a space silently makes website_name return nil and hides the entire website UI element (a behavioral regression from the previous frontend implementation).
issues.zh: rescue modifier 吞掉所有 StandardError，含空白的網址從此完全不顯示，是行為退化。

issues.text: website_name re-parses the same URI up to twice and re-splits the host by '.' up to six times within a single call, which is redundant computation.
issues.zh: 同一個 URI(website.to_s) 在 website_name 內最多解析兩次、split('.') 最多重算六次。

issues.text: A 133-character nested ternary expression combined with a complex elsif condition makes the same-organization decision logic hard to read and verify.
issues.zh: 146 行是一個 133 字元、把「同組織判斷」與「回傳值選擇」壓在一起的巢狀三元運算子，需要來回讀好幾次才能確定。

open_questions.text: Can Discourse.current_hostname ever include a port (e.g. localhost:3000)? If so, all comparisons would fall into the 'different domain' branch on non-standard-port deployments since URI#host never includes a port.
open_questions.zh: Discourse.current_hostname 有沒有可能帶上 port（例如 localhost:3000）？若會，所有比對都會落到「不同網域」分支。

open_questions.text: Is the asymmetry in the reverse case (website is a subdomain of the instance domain) intentional, i.e. should the same-domain-family check be bidirectional?
open_questions.zh: 「website 是 instance 的子網域」這個反向情境刻意只顯示 host 不顯示路徑，還是漏掉的？
